bindings.explanation: When the compare branch of an open PR receives a new commit, the PR's current compare commit must be updated and all existing review decisions on the old commit must become stale. save-new-file moves the branch head to a new commit but leaves pr-1.compareCommit at c-5, so the existing Approve remains effective instead of being invalidated.

functions.name: save-new-file

bindings.subject: saveNewFile

bindings.explanation: A reviewer's new decision must replace that reviewer's effective decision on the current compare commit while preserving the old record as history. After bob-reviewer already has an Approve on pr-1/c-5, submitting a Comment pushes a second current-commit review; both the Approve and Comment remain in the effective reviews list, so an old Approve can still satisfy approval requirements.

functions.name: submit-review

bindings.subject: submitReview

bindings.explanation: Repository identity and duplicate validation are scoped to the selected owner namespace. create-repo rejects any repository whose bare name already exists anywhere in the system, so creating a personal repository named acme-docs is blocked by an existing acme-demo/acme-docs organization repository even though the personal namespace has no conflict.

bindings.explanation: An issue title is limited to 1-256 non-empty characters, and overlong input must retain the original title. save-title only rejects an empty title, so submitting a 257-character title to the seeded issue overwrites 'Original issue title' instead of preserving it.
